notes: A dawn grazer that carries the old forest song in its antlers. Breed with wheat; brush adults for Dawn Velvet.
name: Dawn Stag

notes: A shy dusk forager whose tail marks safe paths. Breed with sweet berries; brush adults for Lantern Down.
name: Lantern Fox

notes: A patient wetland gardener with a living shell. Breed with seagrass; brush adults for a naturally shed Mossback Scale.
name: Mossback

notes: The remains of a broken fire rite. Its melee strikes briefly ignite; keep water close.
name: Ashbound

notes: A grove guardian twisted by a severed ley line. Slow but sturdy; its blows root travellers briefly.
name: Rootbound

notes: A marsh hunter concealed among spirit reeds. Fast strikes carry a short poison.
name: Reed Stalker

notes: A crystal-field scavenger armored in singing stone. Keep your distance from its heavy shove.
name: Shardback

notes: An empty watchman that still guards the ancient roads. Its touch weakens the grip of attackers.
name: Hollow Sentinel

notes: A storm-fed spirit with vast veil wings. A bright gathering of motes warns of its gust; cover breaks the attack.
name: Storm Moth

notes: A nimble ember spirit. It gathers sparks before a burning bolt; the spell never ignites terrain.
name: Cinder Imp

notes: A floating relic that remembers the lost tribes. Its telegraphed chime slows; shelter interrupts the song.
name: Mourning Bell

notes: A hunter drawn to tears in the lattice. It closes distance quickly but cannot cross worlds by itself.
name: Rift Hound

notes: An eight-legged keeper of broken songs. Its bite slows prey without placing webs or damaging the camp.
name: Echo Weaver
